the spatial resolution of a multicore fiber endoscope has a strong impact on the quality of a phase map recorded by digital holographic interferometric methods.
the spatial resolution of a fiber endoscope used in pulsed digital interferometry is of crucial importance for the quality of the resulting phase map.
the quality of phase maps so derived has a strong correlation with the spatial resolution of multicore fiber endoscopes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of endoscopic pulsed digital holograms to the measurement of small objects and the determination of their surface shape.
the investigation of the spatial resolution limits of digital holography and the application of the technique to endoscopy.
the development of endoscopic techniques for pulsed digital interferometry, with emphasis on the use of multicore fibers as the image carrier.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the spatial resolution of endoscopic digital holographic interferometers should be improved by a factor of 10-100 in order to be competitive with other optical measurement techniques.
the endoscope is an excellent carrier of the object information for digital holographic interferometric measurements.
the endoscopic digital holographic technique is a promising tool, especially for applications in the field of microtechnology.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality of a hologram depends not only on the spatial resolution of an endoscope, but also on the coherence of the light source and the quality of the optical components used.
the endoscopic technique in conjunction with pulsed digital interferometry is a powerful tool for the study of dynamic phenomena in micro- and nanomechanical structures.
digital holographic interferograms of high-quality can be obtained with endoscopes of high spatial resolution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the spatial resolution of an optical fiber is a critical parameter for the successful use of the endoscopic digital holographic interferometer.
the quality of phase measurements is strongly dependent on the spatial resolution of a multicore fiber endoscope used for pulsed digital interferometry.
it is possible to record holographic interferograms of an object with a high degree of detail by using a flexible endoscope as a light guide.
